item_short_desc: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Multi-Tool is the ultimate accessory for outdoor enthusiasts and tactical experts. This robust multi-tool includes over 10 different tools, all made from durable stainless steel. The top features needle nose pliers, regular pliers, and wire cutters, making it perfect for a variety of tasks. One side includes a serrated saw blade, Philips and flathead screwdrivers, and a straight edge blade, while the other side has a bottle opener, can opener, scissors, a small flathead screwdriver, and a nail file.
description: Rothco’s Stainless Steel Multi-Tool is the ultimate accessory for outdoor enthusiasts and tactical experts. This robust multi-tool includes over 10 different tools, all made from durable stainless steel. The top features needle nose pliers, regular pliers, and wire cutters, making it perfect for a variety of tasks. One side includes a serrated saw blade, Philips and flathead screwdrivers, and a straight edge blade, while the other side has a bottle opener, can opener, scissors, a small flathead screwdriver, and a nail file. Each tool is secured with a push-button lock, ensuring they stay in place during use and can be easily stowed away. The multi-tool locks shut for safety and comes with a snap-button carry pouch and belt loop for convenient everyday carry. Measuring 6 ¼ inches when opened and 4 inches when closed, this heavyweight design is compact yet strong, making it an essential addition to your gear.
